description: Preview an external wind tunnel quickly from verified cached geometry bounds. Domain corners are metres; relative distances are body lengths. Presets, distances and corners mean the same box for either method; a structured mesh takes the resolved corners in mm and these face names as flow_region.boundary_names. Returns face identities and preview_only=true, never mesh feasibility or cell estimates. A body_min ground is nominal: final mesh planning may add flat-base clearance. Use this for interactive enclosure edits, then retain validate_mesh and native plan_mesh before generation. Does not start a mesh or charge compute.

OctreeDomain.description: Body lengths from the body (unset ones as "standard"; side 0 touches it), or absolute corners in metres.

bottom.description: Below the body when there is no ground; default as top.

domain.description: Preset, relative distances in body lengths, or minimum/maximum corners in metres, the same for either method. A structured mesh request takes the resolved corners in mm and these face names as flow_region.boundary_names. This previews bounds only; run full mesh preflight before generation.

angle_of_attack.description: Degrees, turning the stream from direction towards up. The domain stays on the body axes; the wake follows the stream.

contact_plinth.description: Tyres on the ground: cut them just above it and extrude a vertical plinth instead of the tangential wedge.

farfield.description: inlet_outlet: velocity inlet upstream, pressure outlet downstream, symmetry elsewhere. freestream: far-field patches all round (free flight at any angle); a ground stays a moving wall.

ground.description: "none": free stream all round; "body_min": a moving-wall ground at the lowest point of the body (vehicles); a number: the ground at that up-coordinate in metres.

kinematic_viscosity.description: m^2/s, for y_plus sizing; air by default.

sideslip.description: Degrees, turning the stream towards the side axis.

speed.description: Free-stream speed in m/s; sizes the first layer from boundary_layer.y_plus.

up.description: Up axis, different from the direction's axis.

name: preview_mesh_domain
title: Preview mesh domain
